Nicely finished product. Comes with all the needed accessories for assembly and fixing it to the ground. A minor problem with the concrete bolts, which spun around repeatedly for a while until suddenly taking a grip and then tightening. But once tightened all is fine.
Well made, quite easy to assemble and install. I previously got this type of handrail for my own steps, and was quite pleased, so bought and installed these on my daughter’s front steps.

The railings are a great value for the price. They look great and are sturdy enough for our needs. They included all the required hardware and were easily installed. One issue is the base caps for the supporting posts need to be sealed in prevent water infiltration and rust. The other issue is the lower curled end of the top rail retains water and quickly rusts. Either the curl needs to be shortened, or a drain hole needs to made to allow the water to escape. The alternative is to order the straight top rail variety. More effective against rust but less ornamental.
